repos_data.description: :sunglasses: A curated list of add-ons that extend/enhance the git CLI.

Use your own email from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and other AI apps, on computer and phone. Self-hosted IMAP/SMTP MCP server: no middleman, OPEN SOURCE, encrypted connections and uploads, no tracking, sending only when you say so. Drop a file in the chat to email it, up to 5 mailboxes, add-ons.
